by
  classical
  exact ∃ B : Set ℕ, (∀ p ∈ B, Nat.Prime p) ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2≤X → (((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun n : ℕ => n ∈ B)).card:ℝ)≤C*Real.sqrt (X:ℝ)) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T≤X → H≤X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120+ε) ≤ (H:ℝ) → (((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, p ∈ B ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n)).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)/(1+Real.log (X:ℝ))^A

plain_statement.zh: 构造单个平方根规模的稀疏素数集，作为每个短区间几乎所有目标的一端。
plain_statement.en: Construct one sparse prime reservoir covering almost all targets in every short interval.

brief.zh: 同一集合须服务所有规模和区间。先对有许多表示的目标作概率抽稀，再控制各尺度上的失败总量。
brief.en: Thin the summand set probabilistically, keeping one global reservoir across scales and interval endpoints.
